purpose: Attribute the regime-dependent D3/D4 standard-LARE redistribution error to mean-state constitutive averaging, interface-state localization, or residual interface-operator structure before any closure repair is designed.

trigger_authority.key_observation: Adding a 130-140 cm state reduces the worst common-band dynamic storage error from 2.452332276685631 cm to 0.6877291124718212 cm without changing the HE2021 interface closure.

scientific_question: Which approximation in the standard fixed-layer LARE closure causes the wet-state drying redistribution error: nonlinear constitutive averaging over a thick layer, loss of near-interface state localization, or the remaining Taylor interface operator?

hypotheses.H1_MEAN_STATE_NONLINEARITY: The dominant error is caused by replacing spatially varying constitutive quantities by psi(theta_bar) and K(theta_bar), especially in the 0-140 cm D3 layer under wet-to-dry evolution.
hypotheses.H2_INTERFACE_LOCALIZATION: The dominant error is caused by representing the upper side of the 140-cm interface with the whole 0-140 cm state rather than a hydraulically local state near 130-140 cm; D4 improves because it retains this local state.
hypotheses.H3_RESIDUAL_OPERATOR: Even after constitutive and localization oracle substitutions, a material discrepancy remains, implicating the first-order Taylor interface operator or an unrepresented profile-shape variable.
hypotheses.note: H1-H3 are diagnostic alternatives and may all contribute; C1 does not force a single exclusive label.

frozen_models.standard_closure: HE2021 adjacent-layer first-order Taylor closure already bound in docs/science/F-ROM_LARE_CA1_CLOSURE_AUTHORITY.md

fine_reference.role: physical oracle trajectory only within already qualified DYN0A-FX cases

lare_D3.source: persisted DYN0A fine-only characterization and frozen ODE artifact

cohort.secondary_cases: all seven dynamic cases common to fine Reference, D3 LARE and D4 LARE
cohort.exclusion_rule: Only preregistered domain/numerical status may exclude a case; no exclusion by observed closure-error magnitude.

for_each_frozen_layer_and_observation: mean_psi = thickness-weighted mean of fine-Reference pressure/capillary-head quantity after explicit sign normalization
mean_K = thickness-weighted mean of K(theta_j) evaluated with the same B01 MvG law
reported_gaps: relative K gap where denominator is safely nonzero
layer_constitutive_averaging.interpretation: Measures Jensen/nonlinear averaging error without propagating an alternative model.

interface_oracles.STD_PROJECTED: Evaluate the published LARE interface operator on fine-Reference layer means using psi(theta_bar) and K(theta_bar).
interface_oracles.CONSTITUTIVE_ORACLE: Keep the same layer geometry and Taylor operator but replace psi(theta_bar) and K(theta_bar) by thickness-weighted fine-profile mean psi and mean K for each layer.
interface_oracles.LOCALIZATION_ORACLE: At the 140-cm interface, use the immediately adjacent 10-cm fine bands as the two interface-side states, with their actual center separation, while retaining the same Darcy-Buckingham sign convention. This is diagnostic and is not a D3 model candidate.
interface_oracles.FINE_FACE_REFERENCE: Recover the fine Reference face flux only from verified SWAP source semantics. If the exact face-conductivity/gradient rule cannot be bound unambiguously, mark this component AUTHORITY_INCOMPLETE and do not invent a flux formula.

state_linkage: correlate closure diagnostic magnitudes with observed D3 and D4 layer-storage errors only descriptively
no fitted regression coefficient is promoted to model closure

source_authority_step.required_before_FINE_FACE_REFERENCE: Trace SWAP headcalc residual/vertical-flux semantics and the active swkmean=1 face-conductivity rule on the current branch.
source_authority_step.known_from_current_harness: DYN0A Reference uses swkimpl=0 and swkmean=1.
source_authority_step.forbidden: Do not assume an arithmetic/harmonic face conductivity merely from derivative code; bind the actual hcomean semantics or fail closed.

adjudication.CONSTITUTIVE_AVERAGING_DOMINANT: CONSTITUTIVE_ORACLE gives a consistently smaller fine-face flux error than STD_PROJECTED over the primary case and materially accounts for the timing/magnitude of the D3 redistribution error; localization adds little further improvement.
adjudication.INTERFACE_LOCALIZATION_DOMINANT: LOCALIZATION_ORACLE gives a substantial additional reduction beyond CONSTITUTIVE_ORACLE, consistent with the observed D4 benefit.
adjudication.MIXED_CONSTITUTIVE_AND_LOCALIZATION: Both substitutions produce distinct, repeatable reductions and neither alone explains the critical case.
adjudication.RESIDUAL_OPERATOR_LIMIT: A substantial fine-face discrepancy remains after both oracle substitutions.
adjudication.AUTHORITY_INCOMPLETE: Fine-face Reference semantics cannot be bound without new source authority.
adjudication.note: No numerical percentage threshold is invented. Report componentwise error ratios and absolute dimensional differences; labels require directionally consistent evidence across the primary case and are checked against secondary cases.

next_logic.if_CONSTITUTIVE_AVERAGING_DOMINANT: Preregister an equilibrium/constitutive-aware closure candidate while retaining D3 as state authority.
next_logic.if_INTERFACE_LOCALIZATION_DOMINANT: Treat local interface-state information as the missing quantity; evaluate a physically interpretable interface-shape/local-state augmentation before adding arbitrary global layers.
next_logic.if_MIXED_CONSTITUTIVE_AND_LOCALIZATION: Design the minimum physically interpretable augmentation that addresses both effects, then test against frozen D3/D4 controls.
next_logic.if_RESIDUAL_OPERATOR_LIMIT: Revisit the first-order Taylor closure itself; do not continue state refinement as the default repair.
next_logic.if_AUTHORITY_INCOMPLETE: Close C1 at the state-level Jensen/localization diagnostics and open a separate source-authority extraction before any flux-level claim.
